title: Port the real pgpkeys.git keyring end to end
description: Mark 2026-10-22: suck in the real keyring and convert it. Run git-vouch-migrate port against a real pgpkeys.git clone (~/GIT/pgpkeys, af88128 at filing) with its real commit signer (find the fingerprint from git log --show-signature; do not guess it), and audit the result: every key accounted for as draft/merge/skip/conflict, every pre-filled SSH line accepted by ssh-keygen -l and by git-vouch ssh_to_did, RSA pre-fill counts consistent with the measured 182 reusable / 89 RSA-only / 12 both, the 6 keys with e=35/41, latin-1 UIDs, role keys. Real people's names and emails: keep output local, never commit drafts or paste them anywhere; commit only aggregate counts or bugs found. File each defect as its own bead.
acceptance_criteria: port exits 0 on the real keyring; a written tally reconciles keys/ count with drafts+merges+skips+conflicts; every drafted key passes check_draft; defects filed
